comment: shk.c dopay(): a debug-mode Tourist level-teleports to Dlvl 3, arriving in a general store, picks up a food ration and a potion, and pays with the menu-request prefix so menustyle:full asks "Itemized billing?". 'y' itemizes; dopayobj() then asks "Pay?" for each item, and 'n' skips the potion while 'y' buys the ration. Before yes/no answers were characters, the port never matched 'y', 'm' or 'q' at the billing prompt nor 'n' at "Pay?", and paid for everything at once.
